artworks.title: The  Adoration of the Magi
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius in the style of Lucas van Leyden
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene with several individuals. In the foreground, a woman is seated, holding a child on her lap. The child has a halo around their head. To the woman's side, a bearded elder is kneeling and offering a container with an open lid to the child. Behind them, several standing men are dressed in robes and cloaks. Two men in the background are holding chalices. The backdrop features architecture with arches and towers. There is also a depiction of clouds and a star overhead. Various observers in attire with head coverings are seen in the middle and background. The scene is executed in detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on the Crescent
artworks.artist: Helias van den Bossche after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 28.7 x 18.1 cm (11 5/16 x 7 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman positioned in the center. She is seated on a crescent moon amidst clouds and heavenly beings. The woman has long, wavy hair, wearing a flowing robe. She has a serene expression with palms pressed together. A child rests on her lap, partially covered in a cloth. Stars form a halo above her head. The background includes swirling clouds and cherubic figures holding a crown above her head. Radiant beams emanate from her head.

artworks.title: Arcadian Landscape with a Mausoleum
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees on either side, a high horizon showcasing rolling hills and distant mountains with faint outlines of more mountains in the background. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, particularly in the trees and land textures. The color scheme is monochromatic, primarily in various shades of brown. A rocky outcrop with a tree, a small structure, and sheep grazing is on the left, while two figures sit with sheep on the right.

artworks.title: Venetian Fantasy with the Dogana
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink over graphite with gray wash and white heightening on blue laid paper, rubbed on verso with red chalk and partly indented for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor with buildings lining the horizon, the sea, and the sky above. The style is detailed and features precise lines and soft gray tones. People are shown on the quay engaged in various activities, with boats and additional figures visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Venetian Fantasy with an Ornamental Arch
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink over graphite with gray wash and white heightening on blue laid paper, rubbed on verso with red chalk and partly indented for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with various people and boats nearby, next to a large architectural structure. In the foreground, a small boat is being rowed by two men, with one rowing and the other talking to a woman by some stone steps. The entrance to the architectural structure, decorated with columns and archwork, is visible to the left. More people are walking by the canal, and additional boats are on the water. The horizon is low, with buildings and a sailboat in the distance. The sky above is filled with clouds and birds. The color scheme is mainly bluish-grey, creating a soft, muted look with shadows and highlights providing depth.

artworks.title: Roses
artworks.artist: Richard Earlom after Dr. Robert John Thornton
artworks.medium: color mezzotint and etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III in honor of Gregory E. Mescha
artworks.description: The image shows large blooming roses in colors like white, pink, and yellow, surrounded by leaves and stems. Two birds are perched near the center, with a nest containing three eggs in the lower right. A dragonfly hovers above the flowers. The color palette includes blues, greens, and earth tones, along with vivid flower hues. The roses and leaves are in the central and lower parts, with the birds centrally located and the dragonfly slightly higher. In the background on the far left, an architectural structure is partially visible.

artworks.title: Vulcan Discovering Venus and Mars
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, black wash and white gouache on brown prepared laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: This painting depicts a nighttime scene with a couple on a bed in a dark room illuminated by a strong beam of light. A figure in a hooded cloak with a lantern leans over them, while another figure at the foot of the bed holds a string instrument. The artwork is in the style of Henry Fuseli and features dramatic lighting and expressive emotions.

artworks.title: Head of Christ
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on brown oatmeal paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Very Reverend and Mrs. Charles U. Harris
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. His head is slightly tilted to the side with a gentle movement in his posture. He has a detailed facial expression with deep-set eyes and a slightly open mouth. His long, wavy hair cascades around his face, and he wears a crown made of thin thorn-like branches. The man's shoulders are visible with minimal clothing detail, suggesting a bare or lightly clothed upper body. The background is a neutral, textured surface providing a warm-toned backdrop to the figure.

artworks.title: A Corner of the Colosseum
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Very Reverend and Mrs. Charles U. Harris
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural sketch of ancient Roman arches. The composition leads the eye from the closest arches on the right to those further away. The sketch is done in warm earth tones, primarily browns and tans. The horizon is not visible, as the focus is on the upward angles of the structure where the ruins rise and recede into the distance. The arches are detailed with fine brushstrokes and washes of ink, showcasing textures of stone and climbing plants. Additional structures are visible in the distance, suggesting the vastness of the architectural remains. The image conveys a harmony between the enduring stone and encroaching vegetation.

artworks.title: The Stigmatization of Saint Francis
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a monk in a contemplative pose in a wooded landscape. The scene portrays a monk with outstretched arms. There is a cross in the sky among swirling clouds. In the background, a building with spires is visible. Tall trees frame the scene, adding a sense of nature and serenity, while another figure in the background is seen reading a book. The use of expressive lines and soft shading creates depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Janus
artworks.medium: pen and ink over graphite with brown and pink wash and white heightening on laid paper, blackened on verso and incised for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows a seated bearded man with a full curly beard, deep-set eyes, and a slightly hooked nose. He appears to have unkempt, wavy hair and is wearing a garment draped around his shoulders. One arm is bent on a surface, while the other holds a staff or spear pointing forward.

artworks.title: A Woodland Chapel at Evening
artworks.medium: pen and gray and black ink and wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle. Trees dominate the upper part of the image, obscuring the horizon. In the distance, a small chapel-like structure with an arched entrance can be seen, along with a stone pillar and cross nearby. The trees and stone surfaces are depicted with meticulous detail through an etching technique. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of gray to show light and shadow contrasts. A stream flows under a stone bridge close to the viewer. A figure walking towards the stone structure adds scale and human presence to the scene.

artworks.title: The Drawing Lesson
artworks.medium: brush and brown wash over graphite on cream laid paper, laid down, with a framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals shown from the waist up. The person on the left is seated, leaning slightly towards the other person, who is on their right. This person has an elegantly styled hairstyle, with curls framing their face and gathered at the back. They are wearing a voluminous, ruffled garment that appears to be a dress. The other person to the right is slightly leaning in, appearing to speak closely to the first person. This individual also has wavy, slightly longer hair swept back and is dressed in a loose-fitting, billowy shirt. Both individuals are sharing the seat of an ornately carved chair with floral patterns on its backrest. The first person has a gentle, serene expression while the second person's face is partially obscured. In the surroundings, soft edges and muted tones suggest an intimate atmosphere.

artworks.title: Susanna and the Elders
artworks.medium: red chalk with red and brown wash and white heightening on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts three figures in a flowing, undefined space. Two of the figures have a partial view of their bodies shown, while the third is a more full-length figure situated more toward the center and slightly to the right. The central figure appears to be seated with legs bent and arms crossed or placed across the lap. The facial features of the figures are not detailed, and their hair is loosely rendered. The clothing of the figures is loosely draped with flowing lines and fabric. There are no distinct ornaments or objects in their hands. The background features soft, fluid strokes and shapes creating an abstract atmosphere. The overall composition is in earthy tones, light to darker maroon shades, giving a warm tone to the artwork.

artworks.title: Parc de Sceaux
artworks.medium: albumen silver print mounted on paper
artworks.description: The sculpture is a shell-like structure with a coiled spiral motif on top. It is positioned against a textured wall, integrated as part of a fountain feature. Water can be seen beneath it, suggesting it may be part of the fountain's design. The sculpture is against an architectural backdrop with a row of balustrades above it.

artworks.title: The Cloister of Santa Maria di Gesù at Palermo
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil drawing showing a series of arches supported by columns made of stone blocks. The arches recede into the distance down a corridor to the right. Beyond the arches, there are palm trees and foliage. The drawing depicts an architectural setting with stone arches and wooden beams. The style is characterized by fine linework and meticulous attention to detail, with shading for depth and structure. The color palette consists of monochrome pencil tones in various shades of grey.

artworks.title: The Interior of the Jacobskirche at Innsbruck
artworks.medium: gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and gift of The Ahmanson Foundation

artworks.title: Allegory of Transience ("Homo Bulla")
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: Ruins of a Fortified Tower among Wooded Hills
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tall, ancient tower standing amid a rolling terrain. The horizon is high in the composition, allowing more of the landscape and the structure to be visible. The brushstrokes are varied, creating a watercolor-like texture. The color palette includes browns, greens, blues, and warm tones, evoking a tranquil atmosphere. In the distance, there are trees and stone structures, creating layers that lead to the background. Foliage surrounds the base of the tower.

artworks.title: Saint Peter
artworks.artist: possibly by Jacques de Gheyn II, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing, holding a book with his right hand and a large key in his left hand. He is positioned facing slightly towards the right side of the image, with his gaze directed downwards. The man has a full beard and curly hair that is receding slightly. His facial features appear stern and thoughtful. He is wearing a long, robe-like garment with ample folds and draping. The robe features exaggerated, detailed lines. The keys he holds have a cross design, and the book appears closed. The background includes a distant landscape with classical architecture, groups of smaller figures, and rocky terrain beneath a sky filled with cloud formations. The image appears to be a monochromatic drawing or etching.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.artist: possibly by Jacques de Gheyn II, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing upright with a stern expression. He has long white hair and a beard, deep-set eyes, and a prominent brow. He is dressed in a robe and holds a sword in his right hand and a book in his left hand. The background includes swirling clouds, rays of light, rolling hills, an army in battle, and plants at his feet.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Elijah before King Ahab
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall (arched top): 61.5 x 47.8 cm (24 3/16 x 18 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with a heavenly figure surrounded by rays and clouds above several figures. The composition features a group of people gathered around a stone altar, with a dramatic depiction of a divine or celestial event taking place. The focal point is the heavenly figure at the top, surrounded by clouds and sunlight rays. Below, various individuals are in dynamic poses, some appear to be bowing or reaching towards the figure above. The drawing is detailed with expressive lines highlighting movement and emotion among the characters.

artworks.title: Wild Plants near Birstein
artworks.medium: graphite and pale brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil and ink drawing of leafy plants with large leaves as the central focus. The color palette is limited to shades of gray and beige, with the paper adding a natural ivory tone. The plants extend upwards and outwards, with the tallest foliage reaching the upper left and right quadrants, while the shorter leaves spread along the bottom third, creating a cluster effect on the ground. The artist's inscription is visible in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Study of Cliffs
artworks.medium: graphite and pale brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rough sketch of a towering rock formation on the left side of the frame, drawn vertically with a subtle hint of the horizon at the base. The sketch depicts detailed and precise brushstrokes, creating a rugged rock texture. The rest of the scene is blank, emphasizing the rock's prominence. The color palette is muted, with light beige and gray tones, and slightly darker shading on the rock for depth. A small, indistinct structure is sketched at the base of the rock, adding scale and a human element to the scene.
